lines.en: Thunder clouds gather, steps like thunder.
Thunderbolts flicker, feet catch the wind.
An afterimage of Thunder Breathing streaks past.
One push off the toes, and lightning follows.
Lightning and thunder, waiting for the chance.
Thunder clouds low, waiting for dawn.
Lightning circles as it senses you.
Lightning flashes as it senses you.
Lightning circles as it senses you.

lines.zh: 善逸受了伤，身上流出血来。
lines.en: Zenitsu is injured, blood streaming from his body.

lines.zh: 善逸伤痕累累，虚弱地倒下。
善逸受了伤，气息变得虚弱。
lines.en: Zenitsu is injured, his energy waning.

lines.zh: 善逸受了伤，勉强站稳身子。
善逸受伤了，动作变得迟缓。
lines.en: Zenitsu is injured, his movements slowing.

lines.zh: 善逸受了伤，身体摇摇欲坠。
善逸伤势严重，几乎动弹不得。
lines.en: Zenitsu is grievely injured, barely moving.

lines.zh: 善逸受了伤，眼神失去了光彩。
lines.en: Zenitsu is injured, his eyes losing their luster.

lines.zh: 善逸受了伤，再也无法战斗。
lines.en: Zenitsu is injured, unable to fight anymore.

lines.zh: 被食物吸引的善逸在逼近！
lines.en: Zenitsu is lured by food and advancing!

lines.zh: 善逸盯着你手中的食物！
lines.en: Zenitsu eyes the food in your hand!

lines.zh: 雷之呼吸·霹雳一闪，善逸来了！
lines.en: Thunder Breathing·Lightning Flash, here comes Zenitsu!

lines.zh: 小心，善逸来了要吃东西！
善逸的雷电剑芒闪烁，逼近中！
善逸盯上你了，快给他吃！
lines.en: Zenitsu is eyeing you, give him food!

lines.zh: 被食物诱惑的善逸挥剑！
lines.en: Zenitsu strikes with his sword, tempted by food!

lines.zh: 善逸的剑锋直指你的食物！
lines.en: Zenitsu's blade points at your food!

lines.zh: 善逸挥剑，雷电激荡而来！
善逸的剑尖指向你身上的食物！
lines.en: Zenitsu's sword points at the food on you!

lines.zh: 被雷电击中的善逸倒下了！
善逸与你碰撞，电光四溅！
你与善逸碰撞，电光闪烁！
lines.en: You collide with Zenitsu, sparks fly!
Zenitsu is struck by your attack!

lines.zh: 善逸挥剑，雷电击中了你！
你与善逸碰撞，雷电缠绕！
lines.en: You collide with Zenitsu, lightning wraps around!

lines.zh: 善逸的剑尖与你碰撞，电光交错！
lines.en: Zenitsu's sword tip collides with you, lightning intertwines!

lines.zh: 你与善逸碰撞，雷电轰鸣！
lines.en: You collide with Zenitsu, thunder roars!

lines.zh: 善逸寻找着同类的声音！
lines.en: Zenitsu searches for his mate's call!

lines.zh: 善逸发出求偶的雷鸣声！
lines.en: Zenitsu calls for a mate with thunder!

lines.zh: 善逸的雷鸣声寻找着同类！
lines.en: Zenitsu calls for a mate with thunder!

lines.zh: 善逸发出求偶的电闪雷鸣！
lines.en: Zenitsu calls for a mate with thunder and lightning!

lines.zh: 善逸寻找着同类的回声！
lines.en: Zenitsu searches for his mate's echo!

lines.zh: 善逸发出雷鸣，寻找同类！
lines.en: Zenitsu calls for a mate with thunder!

lines.zh: 善逸发出雷鸣声，寻找同伴！
lines.en: Zenitsu calls for a mate with thunder!

lines.zh: 善逸的雷鸣声回荡在夜空！
lines.en: Zenitsu's thunder echoes through the night!
Blushing, Zenitsu searches for a companion.

lines.zh: 我闭着眼也能一闪到你背后。
lines.en: Eyes closed, I can still flash behind you.

lines.zh: 我闭着眼，雷已经在我刀上。
lines.en: My eyes are shut; lightning already coats my blade.

lines.zh: 我缩着肩，刀却已经出鞘。
lines.en: My shoulders hunch, yet my blade is already drawn.
Sword in hand, heart in battle.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我已经到你身后。
lines.en: A flash of lightning, and I am already behind you.
He has settled into the Flash stance.
He catches the demon's direction on the air.
His blade clears the sheath an inch; lightning shows.
He murmurs the Thunder Breathing form.
He sinks low and gathers himself.
Lightning pools at the sheath's mouth.
He holds his breath and listens to the wind.
His lead foot lifts slightly off the ground.
He looks for a gap in the demon's guard.
A thread of lightning crosses his blade.
He measures the distance to strike.
Thunder Breathing gives him one cut.
He forces his fear back down his throat.
His muscles tighten for a single instant.
His eyes fix on the demon's neck.

lines.zh: 电闪雷鸣，我妻善逸挥剑！

lines.en: Zenitsu's blade flickers in the storm.
Thunder and lightning, demons can't escape.
Lightning and blade, one strike kills.
Flash — the blade is already out.
One cut sweeps past the demon's neck.
The lightning bursts behind the blade.
Thunder arrives only after he lands.
The edge leaves an arc of lightning.
The sword's pressure blows the leaves away.
This strike carries all his gathered rage.

lines.zh: 雷之呼吸，我妻善逸诞生！
恶鬼四散，我妻善逸降临！
恶鬼聚集，我妻善逸降世！
雷电环绕，我妻善逸现形！
雷鸣之中，我妻善逸现身！
主世界，恶鬼出没！我妻善逸！
雷之呼吸，恶鬼无处藏身！
lines.en: Lightning Breath, nowhere for demons to hide!
The thunder comes first, then he does.
He grips the hilt and plants his feet.
He hears a demon close by.

lines.zh: 雷之呼吸剑士被火焰烧伤。
lines.en: Lightning Breather is burned by flames.

lines.zh: 善逸从高处摔落，伤势沉重。
lines.en: Zenitsu fell from a height, injured severely.

lines.zh: 善逸被水淹没了，无法呼吸。
lines.en: Zenitsu is drowned, unable to breathe.

lines.zh: 雷之呼吸剑士被爆炸震伤。
lines.en: Lightning Breather is injured by an explosion.

lines.zh: 善逸被射中的箭矢所伤。
lines.en: Zenitsu is injured by a projectile arrow.

lines.zh: 善逸跌入虚空中，被吞噬了。
lines.en: Zenitsu fell into the void and was devoured.
